title: Spyglass: Now Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing a powerful new tool to enhance your productivity and insights.

title: Intuitive File Control in the Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage and control the appearance of all your embedded files directly within the editor for a more streamlined content creation experience.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap page to effortlessly track our latest achievements, discover upcoming features, and peek into what's planned for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Smoother Task Management
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and efficient way to manage your tasks with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Experience a dramatically smoother and more intuitive real-time editing environment, empowering teams to collaborate with unparalleled ease and clarity.

title: Enhanced Discovery and Collaboration
summary: Enjoy seamless discovery and collaboration on all shared items, making teamwork and idea-sharing more efficient and intuitive.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce extensive international language support, ensuring Noeko is ready for users across the globe.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and the opportunity to directly shape its future.

title: Smarter Constellation: Filter & Explore
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity by filtering your Constellation view by tags, time, and shared connections, transforming it into a dynamic workflow starter.

title: Master Your Knowledge with Advanced Search Filters
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information within your knowledge base by applying powerful new filters, including tags and date ranges, and conveniently save your refined searches for instant access whenever you need them.

title: Dynamic Note Organization
summary: Experience a more intuitive and personalized way to organize your thoughts with flexible content displays that adapt to your workflow and enhance interaction.

title: Noeko's Grand Debut: Self-Host Your Way, Unlock Premium Power
summary: Experience ultimate control and unlock advanced functionality as Noeko introduces self-hosting options and a suite of premium plans tailored to your needs.

title: Expanded Theme Gallery & Visual Enhancements
summary: We're refreshing our current themes and introducing a collection of exciting new options to give your workspace a stunning and personalized look.

title: Personalized Time-Aware Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more accurate and personalized welcome as we update our greetings to perfectly reflect the current time of day, enhancing your overall experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Empower your workflow with new bulk actions, enabling swift removal and organization of tagged items directly within your tag lists.

title: Unlock a World of Knowledge
summary: Effortlessly integrate a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base directly within the platform.
